import json
import unittest

import gen


class ModelConfigRegression(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_authoritative_limits_and_generated_configs(self) -> None:
        models = json.loads((gen.ROOT / "models.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["models"]
        self.assertEqual(models, [
            {"name": "fast-coder", "context_window": 262144, "max_output": 16384, "tool_calling": True},
            {"name": "deep-thinker", "context_window": 200000, "max_output": 32768, "tool_calling": True},
            {"name": "tiny-chat", "context_window": 32768, "max_output": 4096, "tool_calling": False},
        ])
        for name, render in (("opencode.json", gen.opencode), ("codex.toml", gen.codex), ("claude.json", gen.claude)):
            with self.subTest(config=name):
                self.assertEqual((gen.ROOT / "out" / name).read_bytes(), render(models).encode("utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
